reference: 1963, B.M. Kulwicki (Ph.D. thesis, The University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, Michigan, USA, 1963).
comment: ORCHID literature values, Version 1, machine-extracted. Evidence class: experimental. ORCHID observation ids (orchid-literature `id`, one per value, in value order): ORC-54H5OHNIE2

values.sigma_basis: zpf (ESPEI weighs ZPF data by a driving-force tolerance, not a value sigma; no weight set)

orchid_uncertainty.weight_rule: none: ZPF scale is ESPEI's driving-force tolerance; weight left at 1

orchid_zpf_encoding.rule: E2: vertices of phases that are stoichiometric in the target TDB are written with composition null (ESPEI evaluates a line compound at its own formula composition; a fixed composition gives NaN in ESPEI 0.9.1 / pycalphad 0.11.2); the printed composition stays in the literature release (orchid.observations ids)
